in_marathi.name: Atrish
in_marathi.long_meaning: Atrish हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Atrish is a name derived from Sanskrit language. The name Atrish is composed of two words - 'Atra' meaning truth, and 'ish' meaning God. The name signifies the truth that is revealed by God.
